segment.description: The Barren Fork River, Warren County, flowing through McMinnville to its confluence with the Collins River just north of McMinnville (the Barren Fork lies inside the Collins HUC-8 05130107). TWRA's stocked reach is the Warren County main stem; the cataloged North Prong Barren Fork is cataloged separately (north-prong-barren-fork).
segment.boundaries: Warren County main stem through McMinnville; HUC 05130107. Temperature evidence: TDEC stations at river-miles 4.4, 15.2, and 16.4 (35.63-35.68 N, the McMinnville reach) and USGS 03420500 near Trousdale.

coldSource.notes: No cold-water source documented. Catalog describes a gentle-gradient rain-driven river through McMinnville - no dam, no spring source cited by any agency.

holdover.detail: No agency documentation of holdover either way. TWRA's stocking is seasonal (three 2026 weeks: 3/15, 3/22, 5/10, Rainbow Trout); no summer/winter stocking rows and no creel or sampling evidence of between-stocking survival were found.

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout documented: the Barren Fork appears in NO TWRA trout category - the wild-trout list and every other trout designation on TWRA's trout regulations page exclude it (checked live this session), so the agency trout record here is stocking-based put-and-take rainbow only. (Wave-2's audit 'wild-trout candidate' flag was refuted at page level; a stocking program is not a wild-trout designation.)

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: TDEC's 2007-2008 sampling on the McMinnville reach shows summer water of 20-26.8 C (26.8 C in Aug 2007 at river-mile 4.4) and TWRA stocks the Barren Fork only in three spring weeks - seasonal put-and-take rainbow with no documented between-stocking survival.
